# openmetadata_ai_application (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata AI application by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_ai_application" "support_copilot" {
  fully_qualified_name = "support-copilot"
}

output "support_copilot_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_ai_application.support_copilot.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) AI application fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) AI application UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `application_type` (String) Kind of AI application.
- `deployment_url` (String) URL where the application is deployed.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `development_stage` (String) Lifecycle stage of the application.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `documentation` (String) Markdown documentation of the application.
- `name` (String) AI application name.
- `source_code` (String) URL or reference to the application source code.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
